The plan in clone vocabulary, for the analyst

Source: R/plan.R
clone_plan.Rd

The plan of a mask() result, in the names and labels of the clone. It carries the roles as roles() gives them, the linked events and each control spec as resolved on the source. It holds no coordinate declaration, and nothing else from the recipe. With controls() it gives the analyst the pre-declared controls on the clone.

Usage

clone_plan(m)

Arguments

m

A masque object from mask(). A clone masked without a plan gives a plan with no control specs.

Value

A masque_plan in clone vocabulary.

See also

masque_plan(), controls(), handover().

Examples

r <- propose_roles(iris, mode = "local", detect = FALSE)
clone_plan(mask(iris, r, seed = 1L))
#> 
#> ── masque_plan (clone vocabulary) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Roles: 5 covariate
#> • Conditional: FALSE
#> • Ladder: hierarchy; grain: TRUE
#> • Column names aliased: FALSE
#> • Coordinate pairs: 0
#> • Linked-event specs: 0
#> • Control specs: 0
